taxonomy_note: Analyst planning lens; reassess actual root cause.

controls.boundary: SAML assertion and federation binding — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Read the service provider's actual XML/signature library, metadata trust, selected assertion, recipient/audience and request correlation. Identify the element whose verified subject becomes the session.
controls.controlled_verification: Using owned local signing fixtures, trace whether the application consumes exactly the signed/validated assertion and the intended recipient/audience/time context. Compare a valid fixture, an invalid-signature fixture and an assertion for another local service provider; do not execute arbitrary XML gadgets.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A signed XML element somewhere in the document is not proof that the consumed identity is signed. Conversely, parsing XML or accepting multiple elements is not alone a wrapping exploit without selection and identity effect.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Use supported library verification/selection and bind the consumed assertion to the intended service/session policy. Retest normal federation, invalid signature and the specific selection mismatch on the relevant library build.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
